description: Requires the Lumia 2520 tablet. Lumia Camera takes truly stunning photos and videos, and is perfect for anyone who wants to take control of their camera. The Auto mode is ideal for those moments when you need to be quick. Sports and Night scene modes help you take better pictures of movement or in the dark. When you want to create that perfect composition, use the manual controls to change exposure, shutter speed, ISO, white balance and focus.
